segments.title: Israeli Propaganda Ads on Google & Gaza Famine
segments.notes: Case and Rick discuss Google's $45M ad contract with Netanyahu's office, Israeli propaganda campaigns on YouTube, UN famine declaration in Gaza, and tech company complicity.

segments.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple, Billionaire's Bunker, Marvel Zombies
segments.notes: Trent and his parole officer Chris watch and discuss trailers for 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple, a billionaire bunker film, and Marvel Zombies animated series.

segments.title: Speed Racer Fan vs. 30 Haters (Circle Jerk)
segments.notes: Trent defends Speed Racer as greatest movie ever against rotating panel; claims include monkey, John Goodman, colors; panelists voted out via beanies.

segments.title: Peter Gibbon's News Stowaway Hour
segments.notes: Peter Gibbon reads viewer-submitted stories: Victor Ibarbo hospitalization claim, Putin/Xi hot mic on organ transplants/immortality, Pomeranian influencer, jet belly gas study, semen taste science.

segments.title: Semen Taste Science & Dietary Effects
segments.notes: Chet and ChetAI summoned by 'science' trigger; read Cosmopolitan article on semen composition, pineapple myth, dietary impacts on taste.

segments.title: How to Stop Hecklers & Forge a J-Hook
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget searches heckler advice, finds Obama town hall clip; learns to forge blacksmith J-hook while arguing with dead father in wood.

segments.title: Chinese vs. Israeli Propaganda Debate (Technical Difficulties)
segments.notes: Munch debates Crum whose TTS voice malfunctions repeatedly, cycling through Biden, God, and other voices; Crum mostly silent/glitching.

segments.title: Park Opinions: Bush Guy, Birthday Goat, Robbie Love, BOA Candidate
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein interviews park denizens: bush enthusiast, birthday Trump guy, Peter Gibbon (twice), communist chief, rain lover, Robbie Love (roller skate fetish), Vittorio del Dume (BOA presidential candidate), crackhead Yogi Bear, anniversary grass gift.

segments.title: Sign-off & Raid to Gina Darling
segments.notes: Case wraps broadcast, announces Monday/Wednesday/Friday schedule, upcoming 9/19 D&D one-shot with Gina Darling and John Madison, raids Gina Darling.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns for a second consecutive broadcast, opening with Rick to dissect Google's $45M Israeli propaganda ad buy and the UN famine declaration in Gaza. Trent and parole officer Chris review trailers for 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple and Marvel Zombies, then Trent defends Speed Racer as cinema's peak in a chaotic In Circle. Peter Gibbon hijacks the news desk with tabloid stories including Putin and Xi discussing immortality on a hot mic. Chet and ChetAI deploy semen taste science after a trigger-word summon. Jeb Nogget forges a J-hook while arguing with his board-trapped father. Munch debates a glitching Crum on propaganda effectiveness. Trip Bradstein interviews a surreal park parade including a twice-appearing Peter Gibbon. Case signs off announcing a Mon/Wed/Fri schedule and a 9/19 D&D one-shot before raiding Gina Darling.
